newsitem.title: UK: British Biotech shares slip on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: British Biotech shares slip on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in British Biotech came under pressure on Thursday as investors booked profits in the wake of Wednesday's results, dealers said.

"The market is long of stock. The results were not exactly inspiring and it looks like a few people are cashing in and the share is coming off a bit," one trader said. Biotech shares, which have risen as high as 377p this year, were down 14p at 209-1/2p by 1356 GMT. Over 3.3 million shares had changed hands and other shares in the sector were weak.
On Wednesday, Biotech said losses widened in the second quarter to 8.1 million pounds from four million a year earlier.
In a comment, the Financial Times noted that British Biotech remained a core holding in the sector but warned it should only be as part of a sectoral portfolio.
